messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "follow all instructions of your doctor or dietitian"
set: ["follow all instructions of your doctor or dietitian", "follow all storage instructions provided", "follow your doctor's instructions", "follow all medication instructions very carefully", "follow all dosing instructions very carefully", "carefully follow your doctor's instructions", "always follow doctor's instructions", "follow your doctor's dosing instructions very carefully", "read and follow all instructions you have been given", "call your doctor for instructions", "follow doctor's instructions very closely", "follow doctor's instructions during pregnancy", "follow instructions on pack exactly", "follow all product instructions on how to clean your albuterol inhaler device and mouthpiece", "follow doctor's instructions if pregnant or become pregnant", "follow doctor's instructions about tapering dose"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
